derivation: A rectangle 20 ≤ x ≤ 30, 0 ≤ y ≤ 10 revolved 360° about the y axis: V = π(R² − r²)h = 15707.963267948964; A = 2π(R² − r²) (two annuli) + 2π(R + r)h (two walls) = 3141.592653589793 + 3141.5926535897934; 4 faces; centroid on the axis at (0, h/2, 0). The kernel sweeps a revolve as a general surface of revolution and integrates it: volume measured 4.5e-10 off, so its bar is 1e-8; the centroid 1.0e-10 of the size, so 1e-8; the walls' area 2.0e-7, so 2e-6 — above the 1e-6 floor because the face-area integration is asked at 1e-6 and the two walls of ~1900 each carry it.
